prelaunch_updates.text: Science team says its ARC-AGI-3 competition submission reached 0.41 (up from a 0.13 starting best) with no GPUs or LLMs, and calls it a low absolute score. Open Science AMA today at 10 AM ET.
Opened its Skills Atlas: 30 to 100 human demos per task train an "Expert" policy in simulation, which is then distilled into reusable skills. Product progress, not a token event.

Gonka says funds taken in the Nov 18 Ethereum bridge exploit were fully returned. No amounts or transactions were published, and the earlier warning not to use or trade WGNK or the bridge was not withdrawn. Blockaid estimated about $1.05M taken; consensus and inference were unaffected.

v1.2.5 adds block-history pricing (work needed depends on earlier blocks from the same payout address). Activates at block 36,875, about Fri Nov 20 7 AM ET; block producers must upgrade, and sovereign verifiers need ruleset 7 before block 37,375.
Reminder: SOQUPOOL stratum closes today at 11 AM ET with one final payout and nothing to claim. LuxxPool is the official partner (LTC/DOGE/SOQ merge-mining, 0.75% fee through Jan 20, 2027).
Shows two demos (a trading game and a logistics dispatch problem) on XQuad, the toolchain behind its QVM. The chain audit is still pending, with no mainnet or TGE date.
Quantum Alliance founding contributors (including Quantus and Quip CTO Richard Carback) host an X Space today at 10 AM ET on how "quantum-ready" will be defined.

TermiX x Kaito creator campaign reward pool raised from 0.3% to 0.4% of token supply and extended through TGE (no TGE date). Radar only, not scored; content-for-points, not a free claim. Ignore any 'claim' links.
SoquShield wallet is live on iOS and Android; every signature uses ML-DSA-44 and keys stay on the device. Download only from links in the official post.
Roadmap updated Nov 16: SOQUPOOL merges into LuxxPool and its stratum closes Nov 19 at 16:00 UTC. Next release is Soqutomic Swaps (no date).

report.intro: Morning report, Thu Nov 19. One new WATCH: NeoSoul (DNA, 60), an AI-agent trading project. Gonka is cut to 55 after its Ethereum bridge was exploited Nov 18; the project says the funds were returned. SafeTrade showed one new base ticker, CNX (Crynux), but it was listed in July, so it is a CoinGecko coverage change and was rejected at 47. Quantus (80) remains the only strong candidate. Today: Qubic AMA and Quantum Alliance Space at 10 AM ET, SOQUPOOL closes at 11 AM ET.
report.snapshots: Snapshots, not real-time: SafeTrade tickers, CoinGecko categories/new listings, safetrade.com/help and X pulled 8:19-8:35 AM ET Nov 19; prices refresh hourly from CoinGecko.
report.disclaimer: Research only, not financial advice. Never connect a wallet, sign or share keys. Small caps and thin books can move fast and go to zero.
takeaways: Gonka: an attacker changed the Ethereum bridge key on Nov 18, drained about $885K in stablecoins and minted 22M unbacked WGNK (Blockaid estimated about $1.05M). Gonka says all funds were returned but gave no details and still says not to use or trade WGNK. Score cut from 62 to 55.

NeoSoul (DNA) is a new WATCH at 60. It has a named co-founder, an $11M Pre-A (Amber Group, ArkStream, 0G Foundation and others), a live NeoTrade product and published tokenomics with 12-month insider locks. Risks: farmed-looking promotion, a 13% float against about a $160M FDV, and no audit found.

SafeTrade: the only new base, CNX, has been listed since Jul 14 (CoinGecko just started tracking it). The latest real listing is Proxima (PROX, Nov 13), a blockless DAG L1 outside the AI and quantum themes.

Quantum: Bittensor now supports ML-DSA-65 and Falcon wallets on mainnet. That is a sign that established chains are adopting NIST PQ schemes; TAO is context, not a new launch. DAC Quantum Chain was rejected for keeping ECDSA behind "quantum" branding.
Today: Qubic Open Science AMA and the Quantum Alliance Space (Quantus, Quip) both at 10 AM ET; SOQUPOOL stratum closes at 11 AM ET. Tomorrow about 7 AM ET: TensorCash v1.2.5 activates.
